messages:
elaine (product): Quick sync — we need a concrete rollout plan for SmartRouting v2. Customers asked for tenant-aware priority, but engineering flagged cost/latency risks. Can we outline canary slices, flag gating, and fallback policies by EOD?

sam (eng): High level: 3-phase canary. 1) internal only, 2) 5% tenant sample (low QPS), 3) ramp to 25% then gradual. Need perf baseline and a budget for burst capacity.

jules (sre): Agree on phases. Also add an emergency kill-switch and a global fallback route to v1. Suggest we keep per-tenant quota at 80% of normal for first 48h.

owen (eng-ml): Two model variants: full-precision and quantized. Plan: default to quantized for low-tier tenants in canary to limit GPU memory. If quality regressions appear, route to full-precision for that tenant.

maya (sales): We have two paying customers asking for early access in EU region. They require SLA-ish latency guarantees. If we lock them into canary, we need clear rollback/comp plans or they'll pause.

natalie (customer-success): +1. For pilot customers we should add a waiver: explicit opt-in and a 24h support window. Also collect prompt-level PQ/QA feedback form.

elaine (product): Good. Let’s make the launch criteria explicit:
- Latency: p95 < 200ms delta from v1 for common routes
- Error rate: < 0.1% additional 5xx over baseline
- Quality: automated eval pass rate >= 95% on core prompts
- Cost guardrail: token cost delta <= +15% for sample workload

sam (eng): Can we express the flag config like this?
```json
{
  "flag": "smartrouting_v2",
  "phases": [
    {"name": "internal", "pct": 0.5, "tenants": ["internal-*"]},
    {"name": "pilot", "pct": 5, "tenants": ["opt-in", "eu-pilots"]},
    {"name": "ramp", "pct": 25, "rules": {"min_qps": 10}}
  ],
  "fallback": {"on_latency_spike": "route_v1", "on_error_threshold": "kill_flag"}
}
```

jules (sre): Add health checks and automated rollback triggers:
- trigger if p95 latency delta > 250ms for 10m
- trigger if 5xxs > baseline + 0.5% for 5m
- fallback test: canary -> v1 route validated within 30s

owen (eng-ml): For A/B quality signals, we'll run shadow traffic to full-precision for a 24h window and compute BLEU/semantic sim metrics. If quantized performance drops below threshold, we promote that tenant to full precision automatically.

maya (sales): For the EU pilots, we need a special SLA addendum that says: we’ll provide a performance review 72h after pilot start and an agreed rollback window. Can product draft?

elaine (product): I can draft the pilot agreement. Who owns telemetry? We need a dashboard tile: per-tenant token cost + p95 + quality score.

sam (eng): Eng will own raw metrics export. Product: wire the dashboard requirements, SRE: ensure retention window for quick rollbacks.

jules (sre): I'll set up a short-lived dashboard (72h retention by default for pilots) and add audit logs for flag flips. Also add a deploy-bot hook to annotate canary start/stop events.

deploy-bot: Canary start recorded: smartrouting_v2 phase=pilot pct=5 initiated by elaine at 1718206000

natalie (customer-success): Ops question: how do we capture subjective quality feedback from pilot customers? A short form link + auto-attach to tenant id?

owen (eng-ml): Yes — we'll generate a unique feedback token per request and include a tiny feedback UI in the pilot agreement. We'll surface the aggregated comments in the dashboard.

elaine (product): Action items:
- Product: draft pilot SLA + feedback form (elaine)
- Eng: implement flag JSON + fallback routing + export metrics (sam)
- SRE: dashboard + kill-switch automation + retention (jules)
- Eng-ML: shadow eval pipeline and per-tenant promotion rules (owen)
- CS/Sales: identify pilot tenants and sign opt-in (natalie, maya)

Please update this thread when your PRs/issues are open. Aim: pilot start by next Tue.

sam (eng): I'll open a PR for the flag and a perf test harness by EOD.

jules (sre): I'll add the rollback runbook and a smoke playbook to run during the pilot.

natalie (customer-success): I'll ping the two EU contacts and confirm opt-in + support window.

maya (sales): I'll prepare the commercial note.

elaine (product): Thanks all. If anyone sees a major tradeoff we missed (cost vs latency vs quality), flag it here — let's keep it tight.

sam (eng): One late thought: we may need a temporary token throttling policy to prevent noisy tenants from skewing canary metrics. Propose: per-tenant slow-start (max 2x ramp per 30m).

jules (sre): +1 to slow-start. Add it to the runbook.

owen (eng-ml): I'll include a simple A/B scoring script in the PR to compute sim-score and flag regressions automatically.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics export scheduled: jobId=cb-8821 next-run=1718208200

elaine (product): Great. Closing the thread for now — everyone update when your items are in flight.

sam (eng): PR #4287 opened: feature/flag-smartrouting-v2 + perf harness. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pilot/pull/4287

jules (sre): Runbook doc: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/smartrouting-v2-smoke-playbook

natalie (customer-success): Pilot opt-in confirmed for tenant: acme-eu and tenant: helios-intl

elaine (product): Thanks — will circulate SLA + feedback form in a separate doc.
